name: Introduction and overview — Supermarine Spitfire — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — Supermarine Spitfire
description: Introduction and overview of the Supermarine Spitfire: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The Supermarine Spitfire is a single-engine fighter that became the symbol of Britain's 1940 Battle of Britain victory. First flown in 1936, its elliptical wings and Rolls-Royce Merlin engine gave it superb handling. 20,351 were built in many marks; Spitfires served in every theater of World War II and beyond. Baseline facts: Single-engine WWII fighter; 20,351 built by Supermarine; symbol of the Battle of Britain..
